referenceDna.annotatedDescription: A dark, photo-led agency template. A fixed dark navbar sits over a full-bleed masthead photograph. The opening centers a small welcome line, a large uppercase promise, and a high-contrast yellow button. Three icon-led service columns follow on white. A six-item portfolio grid uses square project images with captions. A vertical timeline tells the business story, then three circular team portraits, a quiet client-logo strip, and a dark contact section with a form. Montserrat uppercase display, Roboto Slab body, charcoal surfaces, white content bands, and a yellow action color create a confident studio tone.
